purpose: Convert the V2-amendment precondition SOURCE_FEASIBILITY (protocol_status IDENTITY_COMPLETE_DESIGN_FREEZE__SOURCE_FEASIBILITY_AND_EXTERNAL_BINDINGS_STILL_REQUIRED) into a closed, deterministic, outcome-blind per-cell census verdict over the already-committed source-universe harvests.

authority_boundary.interpretation: A cell that passes this census has a rights-and-bytes-bound CANDIDATE SUBSTRATE of at least 48 units; natural-pair eligibility, target-claim adjudication and external screening remain open and can only reduce these counts.

inputs.role: arXiv metadata signal upper bounds per domain x mechanism
M1 exact-version CC BY 4.0 fulltext byte-binding receipts (recomputed from rows, not trusted from summary fields)
M1 binding terminal + 5 upstream-404 cannot-check rows
M3/M4/M8 PMC OA linked-record rights-clear harvest counts (domain-unassigned in harvest)
M5/M6 Zenodo publication-typed relation candidates per domain cell
M5/M6 Dryad/Figshare/Harvard-Dataverse unique units per domain cell
M6 deduplicated V3+V6 exact JOSS bridge totals per domain cell
M6 V7 targeted identity repairs by domain
M6 V8 final targeted repairs by domain

counting_rules: M1_ABSTRACT_TO_FULLTEXT: bound units = BINDING_V2 receipts rows with status EXACT_VERSION_CC_BY_FULLTEXT_BOUND, counted per domain_id (restricted = provider-native abstract sha256 in the frozen pool; resolving = exact-version PDF sha256; rights = exact CC BY 4.0).

M2_EARLIER_TO_LATER_VERSION: bound units = 0 in every cell; the V2 amendment freezes current_arxiv_pool_capability = METADATA_SIGNAL_ONLY__EACH_VERSION_LICENSE_AND_BYTES_UNBOUND, so earlier-version licence and bytes are unbound by definition of the frozen amendment; metadata signal counts are recorded as upper bounds only.

M3_PROTOCOL_TO_RESULTS / M4_ARTICLE_TO_CORRECTION / M8_ARTICLE_TO_LICENSED_SUPPLEMENT: rights-clear harvested pairs exist (both-sides-CC-BY-4.0 counts in the PMC result) but carry NO domain assignment in the committed harvest; the census forbids inventing domain/mechanism reassignment (frozen attrition rule), so per-cell bound = 0 and the unassigned reservoir is recorded separately per mechanism.

M5_ARTICLE_TO_DATA_DOCUMENTATION: per-cell bound = Zenodo-census publication-typed relation candidates + source-universe V3 unique units; the two route families are provider-disjoint (Zenodo vs Figshare/Harvard-Dataverse; Dryad strict = 0), so their union is the sum; DataCite V2 admitted 0 rows and contributes 0.

M6_ARTICLE_TO_CODE_RELEASE: per-cell bound = CELL_COUNTS_V6 deduplicated_v3_plus_final_exact + V7 repaired rows (counts_as_unit=1, by row domain) + V8 repaired rows (by row domain); Zenodo-census M6 software candidates are NOT summed in because JOSS archive DOIs are Zenodo-hosted and no committed cross-route dedup audit covers that overlap; they are recorded as an unmerged reservoir.
M7_CONFERENCE_ABSTRACT_TO_FULL_PAPER: bound units = 0 in every cell; no linked-pair rights route has been executed for M7; metadata signal counts recorded as upper bounds only.
Every cell verdict is fail-closed: bound >= 48 => CELL_SOURCE_FRAME_PASS, else CANNOT_CHECK_SOURCE_UNIVERSE_SHORTFALL with exact gap = 48 - bound.

determinism.recomputation_rule: the census recomputes M1 bound counts from raw receipt rows and cross-checks them against the committed result summary; any disagreement is CANNOT_CHECK_CENSUS_INPUT_DIGEST_MISMATCH
